title: Old links
author: emulsifier
html: I was worried that all of the old links from reddit, digg, stumpleupon, etc.  Would not be available anymore.  I have made it so they still are (with some tradeoffs).  I am working on getting a widget in here for easy sharing, until then the good ol’ copy + paste will work out just fine.
